name: Azerbaijan State Philharmonic Hall
actual_site: Niyazi/Istiqlaliyyat corner, using the retained complete hall and rotunda outline. This is the main Philharmonic building, separate from the Lutheran church used by the chamber/organ ensemble.
problem: The two-storey OSM tag produced a6.8 m flat-roof office facade. Concert-hall storeys do not imply3.4 m floors. The actual building has ochre walls, white arcades and pilasters, a rotunda dome and two open roof belvederes.

primary_sources.author: Abid Sharifov, Deputy Prime Minister in charge of construction
primary_sources.supports: First-person account of the2002–2004 renovation that preserved the exterior. Betty Blair’s Niyazi Street photograph supplies the arcade, tower, roof and colour reference.
Identifies the main hall with terraces and porches. Scale-model centimetres are not treated as building metres.

primary_sources.provider: Azerbaijan Ministry of Culture,2026 cultural guide
primary_sources.supports: Identifies the1910–1912 main Philharmonic building, distinct from the organ/chamber church.

original_photo.use: Reference only. No photograph pixels are shipped in game assets.

reconstruction.complete_footprint: Existing OSM152190848 in the same geographic frame. Road overlap uses the former facade’s1.2 m mask clearance; the removed area is reported.
reconstruction.section_status: All wall heights, arch dimensions, pilasters, balustrades, dome/tower positions and roof sections are visual estimates with the stated uncertainty. None are lidar measurements. The two-storey tag is not treated as a measured height.
reconstruction.foundation: Original minimum retained scenery-ground value at the footprint. It is not classified ground; the building shares that datum and road/native heights remain unchanged.

runtime_gate: Pending fresh packaged T14/T15 Niyazi Street frontages and a whole-lap Luna High review. Source geometry does not establish visual acceptance.
